senses.definition: conj. except, but (from לָא and הֵן ‘not if’ (cf. Heb. אם לא Gn 24:38); so Nab. and Egyptian Aramaic להן Cooke217, 219, 241 S-CPap. C 6, 7 +; lâinnî, however SocinArabic Dial. v. Marokko 44, Anm. 103; 𝔗 אִילָּהֵין Gn 32:28; 43:3 al.);—
after a neg. (= BH כִּי אִם, q.v.):
except Dn 2:11; 3:28; 6:6, 8, 13.
without a neg.: however, but Ezr 5:12.
